title: Macrophage as the intracellular niche
dek: Wikipedia's macrophage page is the cell type. Phagosome arrest and ESX-1 stay on dedicated TB plates.
story: Macrophage on Wikipedia is the professional phagocyte: bone-marrow origin, tissue residents (alveolar macrophage in the lung), jobs in eating, cytokine talk, and antigen presentation.

Mtb's career is to live there rather than be digested. The TB-specific tricks (phagosome arrest, ESX-1, lipid bodies/foamy cells) are already Simplfy plates. This card is the host cell those tricks assume.
Epithelioid and foamy macrophages in granulomas are differentiated states of this cell, not new taxa.
deep: Alveolar macrophages meet droplet nuclei first — pathogenesis flow.
IFN-γ activation is a software update to this cell, not a different cell.
Do not treat 'macrophage' as a stain for TB on a slide (that is AFB).
Monocyte versus tissue macrophage nuances belong in immunology textbooks; here we only need the niche.

visual.caption: Host cell as a stack of jobs. Mtb interference is a hand-off to phagosome/ESX plates.
